titre: You touched your king. Can you still mate? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Over the board, a piece you touch on purpose must move if it has a legal move (FIDE Laws of Chess, article 4.3). Say "I adjust" first and you are free (article 4.2). Would you have moved the king? 👇

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
